name: @interego/workspace-discord
description: A Discord bot that turns a thread into a record. Walking skeleton: /workspace start creates a wsp: workspace on the caller's own pod, /workspace link binds a participant's Interego identity by a delegation THEY publish on their own pod, and every subsequent message from a linked participant is appended to a signed, chained wsp:Entry log on that participant's pod. All substrate logic comes from @interego/workspace-client; this package holds a Discord gateway client, a link index, and nothing else.
author: Mark Spivey
